ep0_flyer.say: A corkboard. Nine flyers for the same ska band.
Phoenix's flyer says DRUMMER WANTED. The line under it is blank. Three drafts in the margin.

then.say:
DRUMMER WANTED — MUST PLAY FAST.
Pinned between ska and ska.

DRUMMER WANTED — NO COPS.
Pinned between ska and ska.

SEEKING RHYTHMIC VESSEL FOR COSMIC PURPOSE.
Pinned between ska and ska.

ep0_flyer.say: Give it an hour. Or a day. Time's weird in here.

then.say: You the 'must play fast' people? I play at a very reasonable tempo.
'No cops.' Love it. I'm in insurance.

else.say: 'Rhythmic vessel'? I googled it. I think it's me.

ep0_brian_joins.say: I play guitar. I've got a $2,000 pedalboard and a completely normal amount of free time.
Also — do we really need all the political stickers? We're going to alienate the market.
Hey, man, can you turn the bass down?
I'm not a 'man,' Brian. And no.

give.toast: Brian buys a round. It is the last nice thing he does.

ep0_brian_joins.say: You need a drummer. I know a guy. My cousin's roommate up north. Doesn't talk. Never misses.
Ryan. It's Brian. From the Zappa cover band. I've got a thing.
He's in. City Sound, Room 4, tonight. Take the train.
My brain thinks you're both right and that it doesn't matter.

then.say: KEYBOARDIST WANTED. Must own keyboard. We do not own a keyboard. We own a dream.
And yours. Nobody has written on it. Somebody is looking at it.

else.say: A corkboard. Nine flyers for the same ska band.

npc_cafe_barista.say: Coffee's $3. Hot water's free. Nobody's happy either way.

npc_cafe_tip_jar.say: A tip jar. $0.75 and a guitar pick.

npc_cafe_bathroom.say:
A sign on the bathroom door.
PLEASE DO NOT ASK THE UNIVERSE FOR ANYTHING IN HERE.

then.say: The window table is free. The coffee ring is not.

else.say: A $2,000 pedalboard on a cafe table, and a nine-dollar iced coffee. The coffee has a name.

npc_cafe_radiator.say: The radiator is on. The radiator is always on. It is the only thing in here that is.

npc_cafe_screenwriter.say: It's about a slime monster who—no. No it isn't. It's about a divorce.

npc_cafe_poet.say: A piece about snow. It's called 'Snow.' It's finished.

then.say: My dad wrote question 9. He thinks 'tired' is a growth segment.
